title: Bulk Regulations for Area A1
previewText: The regulations applicable to a C6-2A District shall apply to developments and enlargements, except that the maximum floor area ratio permitted on a zoning lot shall be 5.0. However, for zoning lots containing qualifying affordable housing or qualifying senior housing, the maximum residential floor area ratio shall be 6.0.
